title: fix(kimi): support /compact over ACP instead of blocking it
context:
Confirmed by reading MoonshotAI/kimi-code source directly
(packages/acp-adapter/src/slash.ts + builtin-commands.ts): "compact" is
one of the ACP adapter's own BUILTIN slash commands. The adapter
intercepts it before it ever reaches the model and runs
session.compact() itself, reporting back via session/update
(compaction.started/completed/blocked) — the same client-side
interception pattern as Claude's "/clear" (CCC-935). This is distinct
from the kap-server daemon's REST-only :compact endpoint,
